grades.quote: A synchronous trap that has been delegated to HS-mode (using `medeleg` ) is further delegated to VSmode if V=1 before the trap and the corresponding `hedeleg` bit is set.
grades.reason: Provides delegation context, but discusses hedeleg rather than discovering supported medeleg bits.

grades.quote: When a trap occurs in HS-mode or U-mode, it goes to M-mode, unless delegated by `medeleg` or `mideleg` , in which case it goes to HS-mode.
grades.reason: Explains trap routing through delegation, but not how software discovers delegatable exceptions.

grades.quote: An implementation can choose to subset the delegatable traps, with the supported delegatable bits found by writing one to every bit location, then reading back the value in `medeleg` or `mideleg` to see which bit positions hold a one.
grades.reason: Directly gives the discovery procedure: write ones to medeleg and read back which bits remain set.

grades.quote: Page-fault exceptions can now be delegated to S-mode without delegating exceptions generated by PMA and PMP checks.
grades.reason: Provides limited context about separately delegatable exception classes, but no capability-discovery procedure.
